scripts.render: CHROME_BIN="${REMOTION_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE:-$(command -v chromium)}"; remotion render src/index.ts ExagentDemo out/exagent-demo.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --browser-executable "$CHROME_BIN" --binaries-directory "$(pwd)/bin"
scripts.still: CHROME_BIN="${REMOTION_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE:-$(command -v chromium)}"; remotion still src/index.ts ExagentDemo out/preview.png --frame=2160 --browser-executable "$CHROME_BIN" --binaries-directory "$(pwd)/bin"
